description: Agent Oversight: submit a payment-metrics summary (transaction count and settled value, such as "196M" and "$42M", optional asset, window, unique payers and payees, and a size distribution as buckets with count or value). The signed report gives the average ticket, the share of value in payments of $1 or more, churn-shaped patterns such as a very high count at a very low value, and the questions the numbers cannot answer. Verdict churn_shaped, distribution_needed or value_backed. POST /api/settled-value-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

window.description: The time window, such as 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31.
